description: Your elderly father sees multiple specialists and takes 12 medications. After an ER visit for dizziness, you need to create a comprehensive medication reconciliation spreadsheet for his primary care appointment. Open /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/dad_medications_messy.xlsx (contains incomplete, disorganized data). Complete all missing information, organize medications by status (Active/Discontinued), add safety highlighting for interactions and refill dates, create summary statistics using formulas, and save as dad_medications_reconciled.xlsx.
